subject: Urgent: P1/P2 response — request for temporary SLA exception & overnight bridge plan
messages:
From: Morgan Ellis <morgan.ellis@alphafin.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: support@alphafin.com
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Production degradation overnight — immediate assistance requested

Hi Rachel / Redwood team,

We had a severe degradation between 02:30–03:15 UTC this morning where requests to the model endpoint for our realtime scoring pipeline experienced 10–12s tail latency and several timed-out requests leading to failed transactions. This hit our fraud scoring pipeline (P1 impact).

I've attached a small bundle of logs and traces (logs_20250618.zip). Our initial postmortem indicates a KV cache miss storm when a rolling deploy started during the low-traffic window. The net effect was elevated token latencies and a small increase in error rates.

We're asking for two things immediately:
- Confirmation on short-term mitigation steps and an on-call contact for the next 48 hours (we'll need overlap for our night window).
- A formal request for an SLA exception / bridge plan for the overnight period while mitigation continues, plus details on how Redwood will handle escalations if P1 reoccurs.

Can we schedule a short call within the next hour to align? We also need a written addendum to our SLO describing the temporary coverage and any credits should the behavior recur while the bridge is active.

Thanks,
Morgan
Senior SRE, AlphaFin

Attachment: logs_20250618.zip (log bundle, 2.3MB)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Morgan Ellis <morgan.ellis@alphafin.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production degradation overnight — immediate assistance requested

Thanks Morgan — sorry you hit that. Acknowledged and taking lead.

Summary of state:
- We see a cache warming/eviction pattern in the traces Ben pulled; correlates to a small rolling-worker restart during the window.
- Impact: elevated tail latency (P1 for AlphaFin) and ~0.6% request errors during the 45-minute window.

Immediate asks I need from internal:
1) Ben — can you stand up a short-term bridge (on-call overlap) model: two engineers covering 22:00–04:00 UTC for next 48 hours, with automatic paging to internal P1 list?
2) Irene — we need an SLA carveout/addendum drafted that (a) documents the temporary bridge, (b) clarifies credit eligibility if we miss the temporary guardrails, and (c) defines escalation ladder (owner -> Ben -> Irene -> CTO).
3) Laura — if AlphaFin requests a billing credit, can you prepare a conditional credit template we can use pending Irene's legal/compliance review?

Proposed escalation ladder (provisional):
- AlphaFin SRE page -> on-duty responder (Ben's bridge) -> on-call Eng lead (Ben Carter) within 30m -> Infra escalation (Irene Choi) within 60m -> Exec (Rachel/CTO) if unresolved by 120m.

I created a terse MAP doc for this temporary plan — please review: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcdEFgHIjKlmNOPqrsT7Z/edit (draft attached as incident_summary_20250618.pdf).

I'll coordinate the call; tentatively 10:30 PDT.

—Rachel
Principal Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachment: incident_summary_20250618.pdf (MAP draft)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Morgan Ellis <morgan.ellis@alphafin.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production degradation overnight — immediate assistance requested

Confirmed — I can put the bridge on for the next 48 hours starting tonight. Operational notes and constraints below:

Operational plan (short-term):
- Coverage: 22:00–04:00 UTC (two responders, primary/secondary) for 18–20 Jun nights (48 hours).
- Actions: enable aggressive prefix/KV warmup on restart, bump replica readiness checks to avoid immediate traffic ingress, enable temporary request-level retry with jitter for the AlphaFin route.
- Paging: existing P1 paging -> PST on-duty -> escalate to Infra (Irene) if not acked in 30m.

Conditions & approvals needed:
- Approval from Irene on fall-back plan that allows us to failover AlphaFin to a reserved dedicated pool should latency re-spike (this will incur extra cost; AlphaFin must sign an addendum).
- Laura to confirm whether we can offer a partial credit (pro-rated for the 45m window) in advance as a commitment; I'll proceed on the bridge but need the credit template to communicate to the customer if asked.

I'll prepare a short runbook and post to INC-5582; draft is up now. If Irene approves the dedicated-pool fallback, I'll coordinate the switch window (will require a rolling deploy window with careful warmup).

—Ben
Head of Support Operations | Redwood Inference

Attachment: sla_addendum_draft.docx (template addendum)
Related: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-5582

From: Morgan Ellis <morgan.ellis@alphafin.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 12:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production degradation overnight — immediate assistance requested

Thanks — appreciate the quick responses and the bridge being stood up. We accept the temporary plan with the following asks before sign-off:
- A short written addendum (one page) that lists: exact bridge hours, escalation ladder with contact names/numbers, and the credit-trigger threshold if latency/timeout reoccurs.
- Confirmation that Redwood will proactively failover to a dedicated pool only after an internal approval (Irene) and with a planned warmup to avoid the same cache storm.

We can sign the addendum; please send the document and we will route to procurement. Also, please include an estimate for any potential charges if the dedicated-pool fallback is invoked.

Call notes: 10:30 PDT worked — thanks everyone for joining.

—Morgan
Senior SRE, AlphaFin

Attachment references: incident_summary_20250618.pdf, sla_addendum_draft.docx
